newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Joint ex-Yugo succession talks possible soon - paper.
newsitem.headline: Joint ex-Yugo succession talks possible soon - paper.

text.p: Delegations of all the countries of the former Yugoslavia could meet together for the first time in October in Brussels to begin discussing the division of former federation's assets, newspapers reported on Friday.

They quoted Kosta Mihajlovic, head of the Yugoslav delegation, as saying: "Discussions showed that it would prove useful to convene a separate meeting to discuss major issues in this field, which could take place as early as October."
Delegations of Croatia, Slovenia, Bosnia-Herzegovina and Macedonia will probably attend the meeting, the Belgrade daily Politika reported.

The Yugoslav team ended in Brussels on Thursday the fourth round of talks on the succession of the former Yugolsavia that each of the ex-Yugoslav states are holding separately with international mediator Sir Arthur Watts.
